title: My favourite PowerMac is a Nintendo Wii
why_read: A quirky hardware hacking story about running classic Mac OS or PowerPC software on a Nintendo Wii, appealing mainly to retrocomputing enthusiasts.
analysis: The Wii uses a PowerPC-based processor similar to those found in older PowerMacs, which makes it an interesting if unusual platform for emulation or homebrew experimentation. This is a niche hobbyist topic rather than something with broad professional relevance, but it can be a fun read for people interested in retro computing or embedded hardware repurposing. The high point count for a niche topic suggests it resonated due to novelty and nostalgia rather than deep technical substance.
